leadText:
The Pokémon Paradise Resort (Japanese: ポケモンパラダイスリゾート Pokémon Paradise Resort) is an -exclusive location in the Alola region on Akala Island. It appeared in I Choose Paradise!. It is revealed to be a popular place, and thus, it is hard to get reservations.

In the episode, was revealed to have reserved a place for the Ultra Guardians. and took a boat to the Pokémon Paradise Resort, taking their Ride Pokémon with them. While they were there, attempted to steal their Pokémon but were defeated.

During the group's visit, 's friend was revealed to be a regular customer at the resort.

In the episode, was revealed to have reserved a place for the Ultra Guardians. and took a boat to the Pokémon Paradise Resort, taking their Ride Pokémon with them. While they were there, attempted to steal their Pokémon but were defeated.

During the group's visit, 's friend was revealed to be a regular customer at the resort.

==Care area==
The care area focuses on treating Pokémon. Kiawe's Charizard received treatment there courtesy of James.

==Play area==
The play area consists of many locations where Pokémon and Trainers can relax and have fun, including a swimming pool, hot springs, two water-slides where Pokémon can go down in a raft, and a water volleyball net.
